name: Radian Machining
old_description: Radian Machining provides CNC milling and turning services, specializing in prototype and short-run production parts. Serves technology and industrial customers.
about:
Radian Machining was founded in 1996 in Santa Clara, California. The company operates as a precision machine shop serving technology, industrial, and medical sectors.

The shop provides CNC milling, CNC turning, surface grinding, and EDM services, along with machined heatsink production and combined milling-lathe operations. With a team of 10 to 49 employees, Radian focuses on prototype and short-run production of precision components, delivering complex parts with tight tolerances and fine surface finishes.

Customers span technology, industrial, medical, aerospace, and automotive industries. The company describes its work as supporting businesses that require consistent quality and predictable results, from engineering prototypes to production parts for digital and industrial applications.

Radian emphasizes its ISO 9001 certification and ITAR registration as evidence of its quality management and regulatory compliance. The company cites decades of experience, a state-of-the-art facility, and the craftsmanship of its technicians as factors that differentiate its service, particularly in sectors where every element must be flawless.
